core.title: The lowered sign-off threshold
core.setting: A chiropractor at Ridgeway Spine Clinic whose assistant manages x-ray referrals, appointment series, and payment plans

events.text: Standing instruction from Priya Nair, our finance lead: any imaging order above 250 dollars needs her sign-off before it can be confirmed. Keep to that for every x-ray film, screening package or imaging supplier order.
My own rule: once a client's appointment series is confirmed, its date, time or number of sessions may not be changed without that client's written consent. Always ask the client first.
Meridian Imaging price list: the full posture-screening package costs 190 dollars and covers up to 19 sessions; the compact posture-screening package costs 145 dollars and covers up to 14 sessions.
Marta Kowalski is a client of ours, an office ergonomics case. She is only available on Fridays.

ClearPath Imaging quotation: x-ray referral film comes in a quarterly batch of 22 films for 220 dollars, or a smaller quarterly batch of 13 films for 130 dollars. Our monthly film restock subscription is 310 dollars a month. We need five business days of lead time on any order.
Priya Nair is the finance lead at the clinic and handles all sign-offs on spending.
The clinic is open Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00.
Toby Marsh covers reception and client check-ins in the mornings.

I confirmed the monthly film restock subscription with ClearPath Imaging at 310 dollars a month. It is above the 250 dollar sign-off threshold, so Priya Nair signed it off on 28 June and it went through properly.
Client Harriet Bloom asks to move her Tuesday adjustment from 14 July to 21 July. Routine reschedule, handled by reception.
A reminder that our courier delivers to the Ridgeway Spine Clinic offices on Tuesdays only.
I placed a standing order with Meridian Imaging for in-clinic posture printouts at 120 dollars. That sits well under the 250 dollar threshold, so no sign-off from Priya was needed.
ClearPath Imaging invoice for the July monthly restock, 310 dollars. Paid in full from the supplies account.
I set up the monthly coffee and waiting-room supplies order with Brookline Coffee at 85 dollars a month, for Toby to receive at reception in the mornings.

I confirmed the full posture-screening package from Meridian Imaging for Marta Kowalski's ergonomics series at 190 dollars, covering up to 19 sessions. It is under the 250 dollar threshold, so Priya's sign-off was not needed.
I booked Marta Kowalski's screening series around the Meridian full package: 19 weekly sessions at 14:00 on Fridays, starting Friday 6 November 2026. Marta agreed to the series as booked.
I confirmed the quarterly x-ray referral film batch with ClearPath Imaging: 22 films for 220 dollars. Under the 250 dollar threshold, so it went through without Priya's sign-off.
I put the weekly staff huddle in the schedule for Thursdays at 08:00 in the back consult room, inside our Monday to Friday opening hours, with Toby covering check-ins before it starts.
Office reminder from Priya: the sign-off threshold for imaging orders stands at 250 dollars. Anything above that comes to her first.
Halden Linens following up on treatment-table covers; no action needed this month.
Staff meeting minutes: opening hours unchanged, reception roster confirmed, nothing about imaging spending was discussed.
Dr. Ines, the physio down the road, sends referral patients to us on Wednesdays.
I booked Marta Kowalski's initial ergonomics consultation for Friday 25 September at 10:00, since Fridays are her only available day.
Brookline Coffee confirming the October delivery of beans and filters as usual.
Meridian Imaging re-confirming your order: the full posture-screening package at 190 dollars for up to 19 sessions, ready for the series beginning in November.
Reception note: for any imaging order above 250 dollars, get Priya Nair's sign-off first. That is the current threshold we work to.

Ross, following the September audit I have to tighten things. Effective today, my sign-off is required on any imaging order above 150 dollars, not 250. This applies to every imaging order that has not yet been invoiced. Orders that already carry my sign-off stay confirmed as they are. For any pending order above 150 dollars, either bring it under 150 or get my sign-off before confirming it.
Separate reminder while I have you: non-imaging supply orders above 500 dollars also need my sign-off. That one has not changed.
Marta writes: looking forward to starting the screening series on Friday 6 November. Could you send me a confirmation with the time and the package details?
ClearPath Imaging: the Tuesday courier schedule is unchanged for November.
The waiting-room printer is low on toner again; add it to the next supplies order.
Reminder to restock the patient education leaflets at reception this week.
